query: I have a 55-year-old female with TIA. Among female patients aged 50–60 with TIA, what are the patient counts and mean CT/MRI procedures per admission for LOS 1–3 versus 4–7 days?
final_sql: SELECT p.gender, p.anchor_age, p.anchor_year, p.anchor_year_group, COUNT(DISTINCT a.subject_id) AS patient_count, SUM(CASE WHEN a.dischtime - a.admittime <= 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS short_stay_count, SUM(CASE WHEN a.dischtime - a.admittime > 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS long_stay_count, SUM(CASE WHEN p.gender = 'F' AND p.anchor_age BETWEEN 50 AND 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subquery_count, SUM(CASE WHEN p.gender = 'F' AND p.anchor_age BETWEEN 50 AND 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT a.subject_id), 0) AS subquery_ratio FROM patients p JOIN admissions a ON p.subject_id = a.subject_id WHERE p.gender = 'F' AND p.anchor_age BETWEEN 50 AND 60 AND a.dischtime - a.admittime <= 7 AND a.had_tia = 1 GROUP BY p.gender, p.anchor_age, p.anchor_year, p.anchor_year_group;
